name: Desert Cubs – Weekly SEO & Blog Auto-Update (Gemini + Pollinations)

nodes.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash – Generate Content
nodes.notes: Uses Gemini 2.5 Flash. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY in N8N Settings → Variables. Free tier: 1000 requests/month.

nodes.name: Pollinations – Download Banner Image
nodes.notes: Pollinations.ai is 100% free — no API key needed. Generates a realistic cricket blog banner (1280×640). Timeout set to 90s as image generation can be slow.

nodes.name: GitHub – Get seo.json SHA
nodes.notes: Gets the SHA of the current seo.json — required by GitHub API to update an existing file.

nodes.name: GitHub – Push Blog Post HTML
nodes.notes: Creates content/posts/YYYY-MM-DD_slug.html on the main branch.

nodes.name: GitHub – Push Blog Banner Image
nodes.notes: Creates static/img/blog/YYYY-MM-DD_slug.jpg — matches exactly what post.html template expects.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: $('Parse & Build Payloads').first().json.commitSeo, content: $('Parse & Build Payloads').first().json.seoBase64, sha: $input.first().json.sha, branch: 'main' }) }}

nodes.name: GitHub – Update seo.json
nodes.notes: Updates content/seo.json with fresh SEO keywords from Gemini.

meta.notes:
VARIABLES NEEDED — set these in N8N Settings → Variables:
  GEMINI_API_KEY  — Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com, free 1000/month)
  GITHUB_TOKEN    — GitHub Fine-grained PAT with Contents: Read+Write on PrashanChamara/desert-website

IMAGE GENERATION — Uses Pollinations.ai (100% free, no key needed)

FLOW:
  Monday 6am → Gemini writes blog + keywords + image prompt
  → Pollinations generates 1280x640 banner image (free)
  → Parallel: GitHub commit blog HTML + banner image + update seo.json
  → GitHub Actions SSH deploys to server OR server cron pulls
